howItWorks.title: How PDF compression works
howItWorks.body: Most oversized PDFs are large because of embedded photos or scanned pages, not text. This tool finds every embedded JPEG image in your document — including ones reused across multiple pages — and re-encodes each one at a lower quality and resolution based on the level you choose. Vector text, fonts, and links are part of the PDF's structure rather than an image, so they're left completely untouched, keeping your document sharp and readable after compression.
